camel_example: aliyun ndr DeleteBlockingPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Entities.1.BlockingType ip --Entities.1.BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Synchronously deletes inactive blocking policies for the specified entities
description_zh: 同步删除指定实体的未生效封禁策略
kebab_example: aliyun ndr delete-blocking-policy --entities BlockingType=ip BlockingEntity=203.0.113.10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBlockingPolicy

fields.help_en: Required. The object to be blocked. If the type is ip, the value must be a single IPv4 address. IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks, and 0.0.0.0 are not supported. If the type is domain, the value must be a domain name. IP literals and the wildcard character (*) are not supported. The domain name must contain a dot and cannot exceed 253 bytes in length
fields.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象。ip 类型须为单个 IPv4 地址，不支持 IPv6、CIDR 或 0.0.0.0；domain 类型须为域名，不支持 IP 字面值或通配符 *，须包含点，长度不超过 253 字节
fields.name: blocking_entity

fields.help_en: Required. The object type to be blocked. Only ip (IPv4 address) and domain (domain name) are supported
fields.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象类型，仅支持 ip（IPv4）或 domain（域名）
fields.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: The array of entities to be processed. The array must contain 1 to 100 items. Do not submit duplicate combinations of type and entity
parameters.help_zh: 待操作实体数组，必须包含 1～100 项；请勿重复提交相同类型和实体组合
parameters.name: entities
